---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for ContentForge
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem does it solve?**
A clear description of the pain point or missing capability.

**Proposed behavior**
How you imagine the feature working (commands, config keys, UI if any).

**Scope check (please read)**
ContentForge deliberately rejects CAPTCHA solving, anti-detection /
fingerprint spoofing and scraping circumvention (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`).
Feature requests in those directions will be closed without implementation.

**Alternatives considered**
What you do today instead, if anything.

**Additional context**
Mockups, links, examples from similar tools.
